g.text: Dots are five complete-trial folds; thin lines connect the same held-out fold across representations.

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: A separately retrained decoder predicts the five CASTLE phases from each population representation. Balanced accuracy is used because phase occupancy is unequal. Archived LFADS

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: factors provide the highest mean decoding accuracy, followed by smoothed spikes; this is predictive representation quality, not evidence that a factor or neuron causally controls
